Privacy

Last updated: November 2026. This page describes how the software behaves. The site operator should review it before a public launch.

What stays on your device

AI-likeness scoring, word counts, file reading (.txt, .md, .docx, .pdf) and offline rewriting all run in your browser. The text you enter for these features is not sent to any server.

What is sent when a language model is used

The Humanize, Fix grammar, Simplify and Summarize tools send the passage you submit to this site’s server, which forwards it to the model provider (Cloudflare Workers AI or OpenAI) and returns the revision. The tool states which mode is active before you run it. The provider’s own retention and abuse-monitoring policies apply to text it receives.

What is stored

The server does not save your text and does not log its content. Your current draft is kept in your browser’s session storage so that a reload or a move to another tool page does not lose it; it stays on your device and is erased when you close the tab. The site uses no cookies and no advertising scripts. If the operator has enabled Cloudflare Web Analytics, page views are counted without cookies and without identifying you. The hosting provider keeps ordinary request metadata such as IP address and time, which is also used to limit abusive request rates.

Your choices

Do not submit confidential or sensitive material to a model-backed rewrite. Reports, copies and downloads are created only when you choose them.

Contact

Questions and requests can be raised through the project’s issue tracker. Do not include private text in a public issue.
